cohort: The study included 1,980 births to adolescent and young adult (AYA, ages 15-39) cancer survivors and 11,860 births to a comparison cohort of women without a cancer diagnosis, all identified from linked North Carolina cancer registry and birth certificate files.
finding: Overall, preterm births were more common among AYA cancer survivors (RR=1.24), and this association was stronger among women who did not receive early prenatal care (RR=1.73) and those with maternal age less than 25 years (RR=1.80).
gest_age: Preterm delivery defined as <37 weeks of gestation
